rule: Escape-and-return state machine (trigger on route, hit only on one half of the route, retreat to a point with radius, repair threshold 67 percent, then return; camCallOnce so it fires once). Countdown cue ladder: ordered (remaining time, cue) list, one cue checked per 0.4 s poll, cue played if remaining is at or below its time, dropped silently if the clock is more than 2 s past it, then removed. Timers scale by difficulty multiplier, counts do not. Commander escort capacity = base + per-rank x rank index, with production capped at a kill count. Attached units gain +1 effective rank. Escort kills feed the commander XP. VTOL attack runs: each run spends one ammo, empty at numAttackRuns (x numRounds for salvo), cannot leave the rearm pad until full and undamaged. Nexus takeover ladder: first attack on HQ, then unit or building picks, unit pick filtered by experience thresholds that rise with research steps, 70 percent takeover versus 30 percent destroy.

Variant A: boss runs to shelter when hit on its exit half, heals to 67 percent, returns. Variant B: boss stands and fights. Style flag only; published to preview folder, no release rows. Dom judges: spot the boss in 2 s, does the run read as a plan, does the 10 s and 5 s beep move him, does A make him chase.
